screens.title: How these metrics are calculated
screens.body: Definitions · read-only · selected work only

cards.title: M1 · Orders
cards.body: Distinct eligible Order IDs; exclude cancelled-before-start and removed-before-attempt work.

cards.title: M2 · Delivered / terminal unsuccessful
cards.body: Separate selected-work Order counts. Terminal unsuccessful requires explicit UC13 resolution.

cards.title: M3 · Order delivery rate
cards.body: 100 × delivered Orders / eligible Orders. N/A when the Order denominator is zero.

cards.title: M4 · Order resolution progress
cards.body: 100 × (delivered + terminal unsuccessful Orders) / eligible Orders. Not delivery success.

cards.title: M5 / M6 · Completed attempt counts
cards.body: Each acknowledged successful/failed attempt counts once; retries stay separate. Active attempts excluded.

cards.title: M7 · Attempt success rate
cards.body: 100 × successful attempts / completed attempts. N/A when no attempt is completed.

screens.title: How these metrics are calculated
screens.body: Definitions · read-only · selected work only

cards.title: M8 / M9 · Active and pending
cards.body: Active = valid acknowledged start without outcome. Pending = latest failed Order with no UC13 resolution.

cards.title: M10 · Average attempt duration
cards.body: Mean of (server outcome commit − acknowledged start), in minutes, over valid completed attempts. Includes travel, waiting and upload.

cards.title: M10 · Valid event sequence
cards.body: Start ≤ arrival ≤ finish ≤ snapshot. Permitted early failure may omit arrival; incomplete/invalid/future times are excluded from duration only.

cards.title: M11 · Failure causes
cards.body: Count completed failed attempts by reason, including Unknown. Share = count in reason / all completed failures × 100.

cards.title: M12 · Quality exclusions
cards.body: Show duration exclusions, quarantined attempts and malformed nonterminal records separately; categories can overlap.

cards.title: Cohort / zero / display rules
cards.body: Shift start dates, hub timezone, one snapshot; no cross-scope success credit; percentages/means to two decimals; zero counts and N/A undefined rates.
